name: protocol_golden_m6
description: The GDScript codec decodes every message of the M6 golden transcripts (the queue recorded from the Python server: open parties merged, Match Found, accepts, a decline and a timeout requeueing the others, the caretakers offered and started, a race's rival and its caretaker mirror) into the listed values, and encodes each back to the same bytes.

steps.msg: all 157 records decode and re-encode byte for byte
the transcripts speak this game's protocol version
every QUEUE op and the queue's states are in
Match Found, every accept and the decline are in
match_dissolved, caretakers_offered and the queue's matches are in
